title: "Association of MOFA2 Factors with Genomic Alteration Burden"

# Aim

This analysis tests whether MOFA2 latent factors are associated with genomic alteration burden.

The main biological question is whether the validated grade-associated MOFA2 factors, especially Factor5 and Factor6, reflect broader genomic alteration burden.

Burden features tested include:

- WES mutation burden
- IMPACT mutation burden
- WES CNV altered-gene burden
- WES CNV gain burden
- WES CNV loss burden
- WES amplification burden
- WES deep deletion burden
- WES absolute CNV burden

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({

  library(ggplot2)
})
```

# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)$", "", x)

  x <- gsub("(?i)_T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)_N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  x <- gsub("(?i)NL$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  x
}

clean_grade <- function(x) {
  y <- trimws(as.character(x))

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(y))
  out[grepl("Grade II", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Grade II"
  out[grepl("Grade III", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Grade III"
  out[grepl("not determined", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- NA_character_

  out
}

safe_load_rds <- function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    message("[MISSING] ", file)
    return(NULL)
  }

  x <- readRDS(file)
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  storage.mode(x) <- "numeric"

  colnames(x) <- clean_sample(colnames(x))

  x
}

collapse_duplicate_sample_columns <- function(mat) {
  if (is.null(mat)) return(NULL)

  sample_names <- colnames(mat)

  if (!any(duplicated(sample_names))) {
    return(mat)
  }

  unique_samples <- unique(sample_names)

  out <- sapply(unique_samples, function(s) {
    idx <- which(sample_names == s)

    if (length(idx) == 1) {
      mat[, idx]
    } else {
      # For duplicated sample columns, keep maximum/nonzero signal per feature.
      apply(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE], 1, function(z) {
        if (all(is.na(z))) return(NA_real_)
        z[which.max(abs(z))]
      })
    }
  })

  out <- as.matrix(out)
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- unique_samples
  storage.mode(out) <- "numeric"

  out
}

calc_mutation_burden <- function(mat, burden_name) {
  if (is.null(mat)) return(NULL)

  mat <- collapse_duplicate_sample_columns(mat)

  data.table(
    Sample = colnames(mat),
    !!burden_name := colSums(mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

calc_cnv_burden <- function(cnv_mat) {
  if (is.null(cnv_mat)) return(NULL)

  cnv_mat <- collapse_duplicate_sample_columns(cnv_mat)

  data.table(
    Sample = colnames(cnv_mat),
    WES_CNV_altered_gene_burden = colSums(abs(cnv_mat) > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    WES_CNV_gain_burden = colSums(cnv_mat > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    WES_CNV_loss_burden = colSums(cnv_mat < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    WES_CNV_amplification_burden = colSums(cnv_mat >= 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    WES_CNV_deep_deletion_burden = colSums(cnv_mat <= -2, na.rm = TRUE),
    WES_CNV_absolute_burden = colSums(abs(cnv_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

merge_burden_tables <- function(tables) {
  tables <- tables[!sapply(tables, is.null)]

  if (length(tables) == 0) {
    stop("No burden tables available.")
  }

  out <- tables[[1]]

  if (length(tables) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:length(tables)) {
      out <- merge(out, tables[[i]], by = "Sample", all = TRUE)
    }
  }

  out
}

safe_spearman <- function(dt, factor_col, burden_col) {
  x <- dt[[factor_col]]
  y <- dt[[burden_col]]

  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  if (sum(ok) < 5 || length(unique(y[ok])) < 3) {
    return(data.table(
      Factor = factor_col,
      Burden = burden_col,
      Test = "Spearman",
      Spearman_rho = NA_real_,
      P_value = NA_real_,
      N = sum(ok),
      Note = "Too few valid observations or too little burden variation"
    ))
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))

  data.table(
    Factor = factor_col,
    Burden = burden_col,
    Test = "Spearman",
    Spearman_rho = unname(test$estimate),
    P_value = test$p.value,
    N = sum(ok),
    Note = NA_character_
  )
}

safe_wilcox_burden_by_grade <- function(dt, burden_col) {
  tmp <- dt[
    !is.na(Grade_clean) &
      Grade_clean %in% c("Grade II", "Grade III") &
      is.finite(get(burden_col))
  ]

  tmp[, Grade_clean := factor(Grade_clean, levels = c("Grade II", "Grade III"))]

  if (nrow(tmp) < 5 || length(unique(tmp$Grade_clean)) < 2) {
    return(data.table(
      Burden = burden_col,
      Comparison = "Grade II vs Grade III",
      N = nrow(tmp),
      N_Grade_II = sum(tmp$Grade_clean == "Grade II"),
      N_Grade_III = sum(tmp$Grade_clean == "Grade III"),
      Median_Grade_II = NA_real_,
      Median_Grade_III = NA_real_,
      Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII = NA_real_,
      P_value = NA_real_,
      Note = "Too few valid observations or only one grade group"
    ))
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(tmp[[burden_col]] ~ tmp$Grade_clean))

  med_ii <- median(tmp[Grade_clean == "Grade II", get(burden_col)], na.rm = TRUE)
  med_iii <- median(tmp[Grade_clean == "Grade III", get(burden_col)], na.rm = TRUE)

  data.table(
    Burden = burden_col,
    Comparison = "Grade II vs Grade III",
    N = nrow(tmp),
    N_Grade_II = sum(tmp$Grade_clean == "Grade II"),
    N_Grade_III = sum(tmp$Grade_clean == "Grade III"),
    Median_Grade_II = med_ii,
    Median_Grade_III = med_iii,
    Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII = med_iii - med_ii,
    P_value = test$p.value,
    Note = NA_character_
  )
}

plot_factor_vs_burden <- function(dt, factor_col, burden_col, outfile) {
  tmp <- dt[is.finite(get(factor_col)) & is.finite(get(burden_col))]

  if (nrow(tmp) < 5) return(NULL)

  cor_dt <- safe_spearman(tmp, factor_col, burden_col)

  p <- ggplot(
    tmp,
    aes(
      x = .data[[burden_col]],
      y = .data[[factor_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Grade_clean), size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(factor_col, " vs ", burden_col),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Spearman rho = ",
        round(cor_dt$Spearman_rho, 3),
        ", P = ",
        signif(cor_dt$P_value, 3),
        ", N = ",
        cor_dt$N
      ),
      x = burden_col,
      y = paste0(factor_col, " score"),
      shape = "Grade"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    outfile,
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )

  p
}

plot_burden_by_grade <- function(dt, burden_col, outfile) {
  tmp <- dt[
    !is.na(Grade_clean) &
      Grade_clean %in% c("Grade II", "Grade III") &
      is.finite(get(burden_col))
  ]

  if (nrow(tmp) < 5 || length(unique(tmp$Grade_clean)) < 2) return(NULL)

  tmp[, Grade_clean := factor(Grade_clean, levels = c("Grade II", "Grade III"))]

  test_dt <- safe_wilcox_burden_by_grade(tmp, burden_col)

  p <- ggplot(
    tmp,
    aes(
      x = Grade_clean,
      y = .data[[burden_col]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(burden_col, " by grade"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Grade III - Grade II median difference = ",
        round(test_dt$Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII, 3),
        ", P = ",
        signif(test_dt$P_value, 3)
      ),
      x = "Histologic grade",
      y = burden_col
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    outfile,
    p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 5
  )

  p
}
```

# Load MOFA2 factor and clinical data

```{r load-factor-clinical-data}
if (file.exists(FACTOR_CLINICAL_FILE)) {
  factor_clinical <- fread(FACTOR_CLINICAL_FILE, data.table = TRUE)
} else {
  message("Factor-clinical file not found. Merging factor and clinical files.")

  factor_dt <- fread(FACTOR_FILE, data.table = TRUE)
  clinical_dt <- fread(CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

  if ("sample" %in% colnames(factor_dt)) {
    setnames(factor_dt, "sample", "Sample")
  }

  factor_dt[, Sample := clean_sample(Sample)]
  clinical_dt[, Sample := clean_sample(Sample)]

  factor_clinical <- merge(
    factor_dt,
    clinical_dt,
    by = "Sample",
    all.x = TRUE
  )
}

if ("sample" %in% colnames(factor_clinical)) {
  setnames(factor_clinical, "sample", "Sample")
}

factor_clinical[, Sample := clean_sample(Sample)]

if ("Grade" %in% colnames(factor_clinical)) {
  factor_clinical[, Grade_clean := clean_grade(Grade)]
} else if (!"Grade_clean" %in% colnames(factor_clinical)) {
  factor_clinical[, Grade_clean := NA_character_]
}

factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", colnames(factor_clinical), value = TRUE)

cat("Factor-clinical dimensions:\n")
print(dim(factor_clinical))

cat("Factor columns:\n")
print(factor_cols)

cat("Grade distribution:\n")
print(factor_clinical[, .N, by = Grade_clean])
```

# Load MOFA2 omics matrices and calculate burden

```{r calculate-burden}
calc_mutation_burden <- function(mat, burden_name) {
  if (is.null(mat)) return(NULL)

  mat <- collapse_duplicate_sample_columns(mat)

  burden_values <- colSums(mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

  dt <- data.table(
    Sample = colnames(mat)
  )

  dt[, (burden_name) := burden_values]

  dt
}

burden_tables <- list(
  calc_mutation_burden(wes_mut_all, "WES_mutation_burden_allgenes"),
  calc_mutation_burden(wes_mut_rec, "WES_mutation_burden_recurrent"),
  calc_mutation_burden(impact_mut_all, "IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes"),
  calc_mutation_burden(impact_mut_rec, "IMPACT_mutation_burden_recurrent"),
  calc_cnv_burden(wes_cnv_numeric)
)

burden_dt <- merge_burden_tables(burden_tables)

# Add combined burden features
if (all(c("WES_mutation_burden_allgenes", "IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes") %in% colnames(burden_dt))) {
  burden_dt[, Combined_WES_IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes := rowSums(
    .SD,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ), .SDcols = c("WES_mutation_burden_allgenes", "IMPACT_mutation_burden_allgenes")]
}

if (all(c("WES_mutation_burden_recurrent", "IMPACT_mutation_burden_recurrent") %in% colnames(burden_dt))) {
  burden_dt[, Combined_WES_IMPACT_mutation_burden_recurrent := rowSums(
    .SD,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ), .SDcols = c("WES_mutation_burden_recurrent", "IMPACT_mutation_burden_recurrent")]
}

fwrite(
  burden_dt,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_sample_genomic_burden_from_input_matrices.csv")
)

cat("Burden table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(burden_dt))

print(head(burden_dt))
```

# Merge factors, clinical annotations, and burden

```{r merge-factor-burden}
merged_dt <- merge(
  factor_clinical,
  burden_dt,
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)

burden_cols <- setdiff(colnames(burden_dt), "Sample")

fwrite(
  merged_dt,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_genomic_burden_merged.csv")

burden_availability <- rbindlist(lapply(burden_cols, function(cc) {
  data.table(
    Burden = cc,
    N_available = sum(is.finite(merged_dt[[cc]])),
    N_missing = sum(!is.finite(merged_dt[[cc]])),
    Percent_available = round(100 * mean(is.finite(merged_dt[[cc]])), 2),
    Min = suppressWarnings(min(merged_dt[[cc]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    Median = suppressWarnings(median(merged_dt[[cc]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    Max = suppressWarnings(max(merged_dt[[cc]], na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}))

fwrite(
  burden_availability,
  file.path(TABLE_OUT, "MOFA2_genomic_burden_availability_summary.csv")
)

cat("Merged table dimensions:\n")
```

# Association of all MOFA2 factors with genomic burden

```{r factor-burden-associations}
factor_burden_results <- rbindlist(lapply(factor_cols, function(fac) {
  rbindlist(lapply(burden_cols, function(burden) {
    safe_spearman(merged_dt, fac, burden)
  }))
}), fill = TRUE)

factor_burden_results[, FDR_within_burden_analysis := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]

fwrite(
  factor_burden_results[order(P_value)],
```

# Association heatmap: all factors versus genomic burden

```{r factor-burden-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_dt <- factor_burden_results[
  !is.na(P_value) &
    !is.na(Spearman_rho)
]

if (nrow(plot_dt) > 0) {
  plot_dt[, neg_log10_p := -log10(P_value)]
  plot_dt[, signed_strength := sign(Spearman_rho) * neg_log10_p]

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dt,
    aes(
      x = Burden,
      y = Factor,
      fill = signed_strength
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MOFA2 factor associations with genomic burden",
      subtitle = "Signed -log10(P); sign indicates Spearman correlation direction",
      x = "Genomic burden feature",
      y = "MOFA2 factor",
      fill = "Signed\n-log10(P)"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(PLOT_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_vs_genomic_burden_association_heatmap.pdf"),
    p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6
  )
}
```
